BETA Close X CRH plc announced on March 26, 2026, that it repurchased a total of 13,645 ordinary shares on March 25, 2026, through its broker, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The aggregate volume-weighted average price paid for these shares was $106.0751, with individual transactions ranging from $105.29 to $108.48. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and following settlement, CRH will have 668,732,466 ordinary shares in issue. This buyback is part of CRH's intention to repurchase up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026. Disclaimer* 26 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 25 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.060% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
